items.title: Running average drifts
items.symptom: The second call to summarize() returns an average that includes numbers from the first call.
items.rubric: Names the shared default list, explains evaluation at def time, fixes with None sentinel, mentions how to spot it (id() or a linter).

items.title: Only the last handler fires
items.symptom: Every button prints 'clicked 2' no matter which one is clicked.
items.rubric: Late binding of i, fix via default argument or functools.partial, explains closure cells.

items.title: Half the items get skipped
items.symptom: Removing all negative numbers leaves some negatives behind.
items.rubric: Mutating while iterating shifts indices, fix with comprehension or iterate over a copy, explains the index skip.

items.title: Shared inner lists
items.symptom: Setting one cell of a 3x3 grid changes the whole column.
items.rubric: Outer list repeats the same inner object, fix with a comprehension, explains references vs copies.

items.title: Totals are off by a cent
items.symptom: A cart of ten $0.10 items totals 0.9999999999999999 and the equality check fails.
items.rubric: Binary floating point cannot represent 0.1, fix with Decimal or integer cents or math.isclose, explains why == on floats is wrong for money.

items.title: The retry never retries
items.symptom: When the network call fails, the function returns None instead of retrying, and nothing is logged.
items.rubric: return None is inside the loop so it exits after the first failure; bare except swallows errors; fix indentation, log, re-raise on the last attempt, narrow the exception.

items.title: Counter is wrong under threads
items.symptom: Four threads each add 100000 to a shared counter; the result is less than 400000 most runs.
items.prompt:
import threading
count = 0
def work():
    global count
    for _ in range(100000):
        count += 1
ts = [threading.Thread(target=work) for _ in range(4)]
[t.start() for t in ts]; [t.join() for t in ts]
print(count)
items.rubric: count += 1 is read-modify-write and not atomic even with the GIL, fix with a Lock or per-thread totals, explains interleaving.

items.title: Generator is empty the second time
items.symptom: The first loop prints the lines; the second loop prints nothing.
items.prompt:
lines = (l.strip() for l in open('data.txt'))
for l in lines:
    print(l)
print('count:', sum(1 for _ in lines))   # 0
items.rubric: Generators are single-use, fix by materializing to a list or re-creating, explains iterator exhaustion.

items.title: Dict changed size during iteration
items.symptom: RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration.
items.rubric: Iterate over list(stock) or build a new dict, explains why CPython raises.

items.title: is vs ==
items.symptom: The check works for small numbers in tests and fails in production with larger ids.
items.prompt:
def same_user(a, b):
    return a.id is b.id
items.rubric: is compares identity; small ints are cached so it looks right; fix with ==; explains interning.

items.title: Sorted by the wrong thing
items.rubric: Lexicographic string sort, fix with key=lambda v: tuple(map(int, v.split('.'))), mentions packaging.version.

items.title: Recursion blows the stack
items.symptom: RecursionError on a linked list of 5000 nodes, but fine on 500.
items.rubric: Default recursion limit ~1000, fix with an iterative loop, explains why raising the limit is a band-aid.

items.title: Timezone-naive timestamps
items.symptom: Events logged at 11pm show up on the next day for some users, and 'hours ago' is off by 4 or 5.
items.prompt:
from datetime import datetime
def age_hours(created_at_utc_iso):
    created = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at_utc_iso)
    return (datetime.now() - created).total_seconds() / 3600
items.rubric: Mixing naive now() with UTC strings, fix with timezone-aware datetimes (datetime.now(timezone.utc), fromisoformat with +00:00), explains naive vs aware.

items.title: Cache never evicts
items.symptom: A long-running worker's memory grows for days until it is OOM-killed.
items.rubric: Unbounded dict holds every key forever, fix with functools.lru_cache(maxsize) or an LRU with TTL, explains how to confirm with tracemalloc.

items.title: Encoding error at midnight
items.symptom: The nightly job crashes with UnicodeDecodeError on some files but not others.
items.rubric: Default encoding is platform-dependent, fix with encoding='utf-8' (and errors policy), explains locale differences and bytes vs str.

items.title: Async code runs serially
items.symptom: Fetching 50 URLs 'concurrently' takes as long as doing them one by one.
items.prompt:
import asyncio, requests
async def fetch(url):
    return requests.get(url).text
async def main(urls):
    return [await fetch(u) for u in urls]
items.rubric: requests is blocking so the event loop stalls, and the comprehension awaits sequentially; fix with an async client (aiohttp/httpx) plus gather or TaskGroup, explains cooperative scheduling.

items.title: The flaky test
items.symptom: test_ids_unique passes locally and fails 1 in 20 runs in CI.
items.rubric: Low-entropy ID (millisecond time XOR 0-999) collides under load, fix with uuid4 or secrets, and the test should not depend on wall-clock; explains how to reproduce flakiness.

items.title: Slow path in a hot loop
items.symptom: Deduplicating 1M records takes minutes; profiler shows all time in one line.
items.rubric: Membership test on a list is O(n) making the loop O(n^2), fix with a set, explains how to read a cProfile output.
